source: ProductCatalog.cs, written 2026-10-15; 2026-10-15 reglas de uso añadidas tras el banco de práctica (sin copiar sus frases); «arguments»: meanings of single arguments, put on their schema (2026-10-15, own path set 3/8 → 6/8)

tools.app.close: Close one window of an application that is already open, gracefully; never force-kills the process. Use when: the person asks to close an app or its window. Do not use when: closing every window (use window_close_all), force-killing a hung program (use system_process_terminate_named), closing a web page (use browser_control). Examples: «cierra el spotify», «ciérrame la calculadora», «close chrome».
tools.app.installed: Check whether a normal application is installed on this PC, without opening it; when no installed application has exactly that name, the result gives the closest installed names. Use when: the request is a question about an app being installed. Do not use when: the person wants it opened (use app_open), the target is a game (use game_installed_named), or asks if it is open right now (use window_application_status). Examples: «¿tengo instalado el zoom?», «¿está instalado discord?», «is obs installed?».
tools.app.open: Open an application or game launcher by name (Steam, Epic Games, Discord, Spotify, Notepad, Calculator) and verify its window gets focus. Use when: abre/open/inicia an app or launcher. Do not use when: asking if installed (use app_installed or game_installed_named), playing a game (use game_launch), playing music or video (use media_play_query or streaming_play_named), an already open window (use window_focus), a file (use file_open). Examples: «abre steam», «ábreme el discord», «open spotify». Look at the window afterwards to see where it arrived.
tools.audio.app.volume.adjust: Raise or lower one application's volume (its mixer slider) by an amount from its current level; master volume untouched. Use when: an app is named with sube/baja/más/menos and an amount. Do not use when: an exact target level (use audio_app_volume_set), no app named (use audio_volume_adjust). Examples: «bájale 20 al spotify», «sube el volumen de discord en 10», «turn down chrome by 15».
tools.audio.app.volume.set: Set one application's volume (its mixer slider) to an exact level 0-100, even while paused; master volume untouched. Use when: an app is named with a target number or percent. Do not use when: raising or lowering by an amount (use audio_app_volume_adjust), no app named (use audio_volume). Examples: «pon el spotify al 30», «discord al 50 por ciento», «set chrome volume to 20».
tools.audio.microphone.mute: Mute or unmute the default microphone (sound input). Use when: the person mentions the micrófono or mic. Do not use when: muting the speakers or headphones (use audio_mute). Examples: «silencia el micrófono», «activa el micro de nuevo», «mutea el mic».
tools.audio.mute: Mute or unmute the PC sound output (speakers or headphones). Use when: silencia, mutea or quita el silencio for the sound in general. Do not use when: the microphone (use audio_microphone_mute), pausing what plays (use media_control), changing the level (use audio_volume or audio_volume_adjust). Examples: «silencia el pc», «quítale el mute», «mute the sound». This is the operation for silencing the whole PC or computer: silencing never turns anything off.
tools.audio.status: Read which audio output is in use, its volume and whether it is muted, without changing anything. Use when: the person asks the current volume or where the sound comes out. Do not use when: changing the volume (use audio_volume or audio_volume_adjust), asking which song plays (use media_status). Examples: «¿en cuánto está el volumen?», «¿por dónde sale el sonido?», «¿está muteado el pc?».
tools.audio.volume: Set the PC master volume to an exact level 0-100. Use when: a target number or percent is given («al 50», «a 40», «en 30»), even with the verb sube/baja. Do not use when: raising or lowering by an amount from the current level (use audio_volume_adjust), one app only (use audio_app_volume_set), muting (use audio_mute). Examples: «pon el volumen al 50», «volumen en 20», «sube el volumen al 80».
tools.audio.volume.adjust: Raise or lower the PC master volume by an amount from its current level. Use when: sube/baja/más/menos with an amount and no target level. Do not use when: a target level is given with «al N», «a N» or «en N» (use audio_volume), one app only (use audio_app_volume_adjust). Examples: «sube el volumen 10», «bájale 20 al volumen», «turn it down by 5».
tools.backup.create: Make a private backup copy of one file already identified by BAXY (resource id and hash); its SHA-256 is checked against the original and recorded. Use when: backing up a single file found earlier. Do not use when: a whole known folder (use backup_known_create), zipping (use file_compress). Examples: «haz un respaldo de ese archivo», «sácale una copia de seguridad al informe», «backup ese archivo».
tools.backup.known.create: Create a verified ZIP backup of a known folder: desktop, documents, pictures, projects or all of them. Use when: respaldar or backup of a whole folder. Do not use when: backing up one single file (use backup_create), just zipping a file or folder next to itself (use file_compress). Examples: «haz un backup de documentos», «respalda el escritorio», «backup de mis fotos».
tools.backup.known.list: List the ZIP backups of known folders and re-verify that they are intact. Use when: asking which folder backups exist. Do not use when: backups of single files (use backup_list). Examples: «¿qué respaldos de carpetas tengo?», «muéstrame los backups de documentos», «lista mis copias de seguridad de carpetas».
tools.backup.known.restore.latest: Restore the most recent ZIP backup of a known folder by extracting it into a new separate folder; the original is not overwritten. Use when: recuperar or restaurar a folder backup. Do not use when: only checking integrity (use backup_known_verify_latest), a single-file backup (use backup_restore). Examples: «restaura el último backup de documentos», «recupera el respaldo del escritorio», «restore my pictures backup».
tools.backup.known.verify.latest: Check that the most recent ZIP backup of a known folder is intact (SHA-256), without restoring it. Use when: asking whether a folder backup is OK. Do not use when: restoring it (use backup_known_restore_latest), a single-file backup (use backup_verify). Examples: «verifica el último respaldo de documentos», «¿está bien el backup del escritorio?», «chequea el backup de fotos».
tools.backup.list: List the private backups of single files, newest first, each saying whether it still has the SHA-256 recorded when it was made. Use when: asking about backups of individual files. Do not use when: ZIP backups of whole folders (use backup_known_list). Examples: «¿qué archivos tengo respaldados?», «lista los respaldos de archivos», «muéstrame las copias de archivos sueltos».
tools.backup.restore: Restore a single-file backup into a free path of BAXY's private work folder (sandbox); a backup changed since it was made, or without its recorded SHA-256, is not restored. Use when: recovering a file backup listed earlier. Do not use when: a folder ZIP backup (use backup_known_restore_latest). Examples: «restaura ese respaldo», «recupera la copia del informe», «restore that backup».
tools.backup.verify: Check that a private single-file backup is intact (its SHA-256 against the one recorded when it was made), without restoring it. Use when: asking whether one file backup is OK. Do not use when: a folder ZIP backup (use backup_known_verify_latest), restoring it (use backup_restore). Examples: «verifica ese respaldo», «¿está intacta la copia del informe?», «check that backup».
tools.bluetooth.device.list: List the available Bluetooth devices, without connecting any. Use when: asking which Bluetooth devices are around. Do not use when: pairing one (use bluetooth_device_pair), asking whether Bluetooth is on (use bluetooth_radio_status), wired peripherals (use peripheral_list). Examples: «¿qué dispositivos bluetooth hay?», «busca audífonos bluetooth», «lista los bluetooth».
tools.bluetooth.device.pair: Pair an already identified Bluetooth device through Windows' own pairing dialog and permission. Use when: emparejar, vincular or conectar a Bluetooth device. Do not use when: only listing devices (use bluetooth_device_list), turning Bluetooth on (use bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «empareja mis audífonos», «vincula el parlante bluetooth», «pair the jbl».
tools.bluetooth.radio.set: Turn the PC's Bluetooth radio on or off. Use when: prende/apaga/activa/desactiva el bluetooth. Do not use when: only asking its state (use bluetooth_radio_status), Wi-Fi (use wifi_radio_set), airplane mode for all radios (use system_settings_set). Examples: «prende el bluetooth», «apaga el bluetooth», «turn on bluetooth».
tools.bluetooth.radio.status: Read whether Bluetooth is on or off, without changing it. Use when: asking about the Bluetooth state. Do not use when: switching it (use bluetooth_radio_set), listing devices (use bluetooth_device_list). Examples: «¿está prendido el bluetooth?», «¿tengo el bluetooth activado?», «¿el bluetooth está on?».
tools.browser.control: Act on the active tab of the person's own default browser (its front window): back, reload, scroll up or down, new tab, fullscreen video, close the page or all pages. Use when: the person refers to the current page. Do not use when: a new address (use browser_navigate), scrolling a non-browser window (use input_pointer_control), closing another app (use app_close). Examples: «vuelve atrás», «baja en la página», «recarga la página».
tools.browser.navigate: Go to an exact web address in the person's browser; also open a search-results page there when the engine or browser is named as the place («búscalo en Google»). Use when: a URL or site is given. Do not use when: a browser is named (use browser_navigate_named), an answer is wanted (use web_search), a YouTube video should play (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «abre youtube.com», «ve a wikipedia.org», «búscalo en google». Never use it to reach a section of a desktop application that is open on screen (a library, a tab, a settings page): that is app_open with place when the section is one of its places, otherwise input_visible_click on its label.
tools.browser.navigate.named: Open a web address in a named browser: Opera, Opera GX, Chrome, Edge or Brave. Use when: the person names one of those browsers as where the page opens. Do not use when: no browser is named (use browser_navigate), only the browser app is wanted with no page (use app_open). Examples: «abre youtube en opera gx», «abre gmail en chrome», «open netflix.com en edge».
tools.browser.page.read: Read the title, address and visible text of the page in front in the person's own default browser, without touching it. Use when: asking what the current page says or to summarize it. Do not use when: a PDF or text file (use file_read), searching the internet (use web_search), listing tabs (use browser_tabs_list). Examples: «¿qué dice esta página?», «resúmeme la página», «lee la web abierta».
tools.browser.tabs.list: List the tabs of the person's own default browser (its front window), with title and address. Use when: asking which tabs or pestañas are open. Do not use when: reading one page's text (use browser_page_read), asking which app window is in front (use window_active). Examples: «¿qué pestañas tengo abiertas?», «lista las pestañas», «muéstrame los tabs».
tools.calculator.expression.evaluate: Type a simple arithmetic expression into the open Windows Calculator and read the result it displays. Use when: the person asks to compute something in the Calculator. Do not use when: the Calculator should only be opened (use app_open). Examples: «calcula 25 por 4 en la calculadora», «usa la calculadora para 120 entre 3», «súmalo en la calculadora: 15 más 27». Only when the person explicitly asks to use the Calculator app; a plain arithmetic question is answered directly in text, without tools. It must be open first (app_open).
tools.calendar.event.create: Create an event with a title, start time and end time in the person's Outlook calendar, which syncs it to their account; BAXY asks the person first. Use when: agendar a meeting or appointment with a time span. Do not use when: something must ring or remind at a time (use schedule_alarms), a to-do (use task_create). Examples: «agenda una reunión mañana de 3 a 4», «crea un evento el viernes de 10 a 11», «dentista en el calendario el lunes de 9 a 10».
tools.calendar.event.list: List the calendar events between two dates or times, without changing them. Use when: asking what is on the calendar or agenda: meetings today, the next meeting, who attends. Do not use when: alarms or reminders (use schedule_alarms), tasks (use task_list). Examples: «¿qué tengo en el calendario mañana?», «muéstrame mis eventos de esta semana», «¿tengo reuniones hoy?».
tools.capture.active.window: Take a screenshot of only the active window; optionally also save it as PNG in a known folder. Use when: the capture is of this window or the current app. Do not use when: the whole desktop (use capture_screenshot), reading or describing the screen (use ocr_read or vision_describe after a capture). Examples: «captura la ventana activa», «sácale foto a esta ventana», «screenshot de esta ventana».
tools.capture.screenshot: Take a screenshot of the whole desktop; optionally also save it as PNG in a known folder (desktop, documents, downloads, pictures). Use when: captura de pantalla, pantallazo or screenshot without limiting it to one window. Do not use when: only the active window (use capture_active_window). Examples: «toma una captura de pantalla», «saca un pantallazo y guárdalo en el escritorio», «haz un screenshot».
tools.client.channel.locate: Search Discord's quick switcher for a channel or chat by name and say whether a row with exactly that name appears (the switcher's rows come back as shown), joining or opening nothing. Use when: whether a Discord channel or chat exists. Do not use when: writing a message (use message_draft), opening Discord (use app_open). Examples: «busca el canal general en discord», «¿está el canal de música en discord?», «find the memes channel en discord».
tools.clipboard.copy: Copy what is selected in the active window, like Ctrl+C. Use when: copia esto or copy the selection. Do not use when: putting a given text in the clipboard (use clipboard_write_text), reading what was copied (use clipboard_read_text), selecting first (use input_select_all). Examples: «copia lo seleccionado», «cópialo», «copy this».
tools.clipboard.paste: Paste the clipboard contents where the cursor is, like Ctrl+V. Use when: pega or paste. Do not use when: typing a given text (use input_text_type), reading the clipboard aloud (use clipboard_read_text). Examples: «pega aquí», «pégalo», «paste it».
tools.clipboard.read.text: Read the text currently in the clipboard, without changing it. Use when: asking what was copied. Do not use when: pasting it somewhere (use clipboard_paste), copying the selection (use clipboard_copy). Examples: «¿qué tengo copiado?», «lee el portapapeles», «what's in my clipboard?».
tools.clipboard.write.text: Put a given text into the clipboard for later pasting, without copying anything from the screen. Use when: the person dictates the text to place in the clipboard. Do not use when: copying the on-screen selection (use clipboard_copy), typing the text directly (use input_text_type). Examples: «copia al portapapeles hola mundo», «pon en el portapapeles 'nos vemos a las 8'», «guarda 'listo' en el clipboard».
tools.desktop.wallpaper.set: Change the desktop wallpaper to a solid color, written as #RRGGBB (azul #004E98, negro #000000), or to an image from a known folder (desktop, documents, downloads, pictures). Use when: cambia el fondo de pantalla or wallpaper. Do not use when: brightness (use system_settings_set). Examples: «cambia el fondo de pantalla a azul», «pon de fondo playa.jpg de imágenes», «cambia el wallpaper a negro».
tools.display.status: Read which monitors are connected and their resolution and refresh rate, without changing anything. Use when: asking about monitors, resolution or Hz. Do not use when: brightness (use system_settings_status), general PC specs (use system_status). Examples: «¿cuántos monitores tengo?», «¿qué resolución tiene la pantalla?», «¿a cuántos hz está el monitor?».
tools.document.presentation.create: Create a PowerPoint (.pptx) with a title and slides (first line the slide title, the rest bullets) in a known folder. Use when: hazme un powerpoint or una presentación. Do not use when: Word or Excel (use office_document_create), a plain text file (use file_write). Examples: «haz un powerpoint de 5 diapositivas sobre el reciclaje», «crea una presentación sobre Chile», «make a ppt de marketing».
tools.email.latest.read: Read the most recent email received in Outlook. Use when: asking for the last or newest email. Do not use when: replying to it (use email_latest_reply), writing a new email (use email_send). Examples: «lee mi último correo», «¿qué dice el último mail?», «read my latest email».
tools.email.latest.reply: Reply with a given text to the most recent email received in Outlook. Use when: respóndele or contéstale al último correo. Do not use when: a new email to an address (use email_send), only reading it (use email_latest_read). Examples: «responde al último correo que llego tarde», «contéstale al último mail: gracias», «reply ok al último email».
tools.email.send: Send a new email to an address, with an optional subject, from the owner's Outlook. Use when: a correo or mail to a given address with its text. Do not use when: replying to the last email (use email_latest_reply), WhatsApp or Discord (use message_draft), a test send (use message_send_test). Examples: «manda un correo a juan@gmail.com que mañana no voy», «envía un mail a ana@empresa.cl con asunto reunión», «send an email a pedro@mail.com: listo».
tools.file.compress: Compress a file or folder from a known folder into a ZIP with the same name next to it. Use when: comprimir or zipear. Do not use when: a verified backup of a whole known folder (use backup_known_create). Examples: «comprime la carpeta fotos del escritorio», «haz un zip de informe.docx en documentos», «zipea proyecto en descargas».
tools.file.edit: Replace an exact piece of text with another in a text file of a known folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder), by the file's name or the relativePath file_find gave; the previous version goes to the Recycle Bin. Use when: cambia X por Y en un archivo, corrige una línea or a word inside a file. Do not use when: writing the whole content (use file_write), adding at the end (use file_write with append), a note (use note_update). Examples: «en notas.txt cambia lunes por martes», «corrige 'hloa' por 'hola' en el readme.md», «reemplaza todas las veces 2024 por 2025 en informe.md».
tools.file.find: List the top level of a known folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder, or all), or find files under it by name (part of the name, or a pattern like *.pdf) or by a text inside its text files; order recent puts the newest first and order size the largest first, and each file comes with its relativePath and size in bytes. A search that took too long says timeLimitReached: what it found so far, not all. Use when: qué hay en a folder, busca el archivo X, dónde está mi X, which file mentions X. Do not use when: BAXY's private work folder (use filesystem_list or filesystem_search), reading a file (use file_read), notes (use note_search), the internet (use web_search). Examples: «¿qué hay en el escritorio?», «busca el archivo presupuesto», «¿qué archivo de documentos habla de la reunión con Juan?».
tools.file.open: Open a specific file by its name from a known folder with its default app or a named installed app. name may carry subfolders of that folder («proyecto\informe.docx»). A file not there is not opened: the receipt (seenElsewhere) says in which known folder, and under which subfolders, a file of that exact name was seen, so you can open it from there. Use when: abre el archivo X. Do not use when: the newest unnamed file (use filesystem_file_open_latest), a folder (use filesystem_folder_open), an application (use app_open), reading without showing (use file_read). Examples: «abre tarea.docx del escritorio», «abre foto.png de descargas con paint», «open informe.pdf».
tools.file.read: Read the text of a file by its name (or the relativePath file_find gave) from a known folder: a text or code file (txt, md, json, code) or a PDF (its own text, no OCR), without opening it on screen. totalLines is how many lines the whole file has and lines how many the returned text has, already counted: say those numbers, never count yourself. Use when: qué dice, resume or lee a named file. Do not use when: showing it on screen (use file_open), a file in BAXY's private work folder (use filesystem_read_text), the open web page (use browser_page_read), a Word or Excel document BAXY created (use office_document_read). Examples: «resume el pdf contrato.pdf», «¿de qué trata el roadmap.md?», «léeme notas.txt del escritorio».
tools.file.write: Write text to a file in Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder or BAXY's work folder: create it, replace an existing one (pass expectedSha256, the fileSha256 file_read gave; its previous version goes to the Recycle Bin), or with append true add the text as a new line at the end, keeping what is there. Use when: crea un archivo de texto, escribe X en un archivo, agrega una línea al final de un archivo. Do not use when: changing only part of a file (use file_edit), a note (use note_create), Word or Excel (use office_document_create), a PowerPoint (use document_presentation_create). Examples: «crea hola.txt en el escritorio que diga hola», «agrega 'comprar pan' al final de lista.txt», «save this en notas.txt».
tools.filesystem.copy: Copy an already identified file to another path inside BAXY's private work folder, verifying its hash. Use when: copying a sandbox file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: a backup (use backup_create), files in Desktop, Documents or Downloads (sandbox only). Examples: «copia ese archivo a la carpeta respaldo», «duplica notas.txt en tu carpeta de trabajo», «copy it to otra carpeta».
tools.filesystem.create.directory: Create a new folder in Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder or BAXY's private work folder. Use when: crea una carpeta. Do not use when: opening an existing folder (use filesystem_folder_open), creating a file (use file_write). Examples: «crea una carpeta proyectos en el escritorio», «haz una carpeta nueva llamada fotos en documentos», «make a folder tareas en descargas».
tools.filesystem.explorer.count: Count how many files with an extension are directly in a folder: the known folder the person names (folder: desktop, documents, downloads, home, pictures), or without folder the one shown by the File Explorer window in front (no_explorer_in_front: none is in front; ask which folder). Use when: cuántos archivos .X hay. Do not use when: listing or searching files (use file_find). Examples: «¿cuántos archivos .py hay en esta carpeta?», «cuenta los pdf del escritorio», «how many jpg hay aquí?».
tools.filesystem.file.open.latest: Open the most recently modified file of a known folder, without the person naming it. Use when: lo último que descargué or el archivo más reciente. Do not use when: the file is named (use file_open), opening the folder itself (use filesystem_folder_open). Examples: «abre el último archivo de descargas», «abre lo último que bajé», «open the newest file en documentos».
tools.filesystem.folder.open: Open a known Windows folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, the user's home folder), or a folder inside it (subdirectory), in File Explorer. Use when: abre la carpeta de descargas or documentos. Do not use when: saying its contents aloud (use file_find), opening a file (use file_open), creating a folder (use filesystem_create_directory). Examples: «abre descargas», «ábreme la carpeta documentos», «open my pictures folder».
tools.filesystem.known.duplicates: Find duplicate files in Downloads (same size and SHA-256), without deleting or changing anything. Use when: archivos repetidos or duplicados. Do not use when: deleting a file (use filesystem_known_trash_named), comparing two text files line by line (use filesystem_sandbox_diff_named). Examples: «busca archivos duplicados en descargas», «¿tengo archivos repetidos?», «find duplicates en downloads».
tools.filesystem.known.trash.named: Delete a file by its name from a known folder (or a folder inside it, subdirectory; the user's home folder too) by sending it to the Windows Recycle Bin; the person can restore it from there. Use when: borra or elimina the file X. Do not use when: emptying the Windows Recycle Bin (use system_recyclebin_empty), a note or task (use note_trash or task_delete), an alarm or reminder (use schedule_alarms). Examples: «borra viejo.txt del escritorio», «elimina foto1.png de descargas», «delete tarea.docx».
tools.filesystem.list: List what is in BAXY's private work folder (sandbox), never the person's folders (their home folder and everything under it are file_find). Use when: the person refers to BAXY's own work folder. Do not use when: Desktop, Documents, Downloads or any folder the person names, even one whose name contains BAXY: it is theirs (use file_find). Examples: «¿qué hay en tu carpeta de trabajo?», «lista tus archivos de trabajo», «muéstrame el sandbox».
tools.filesystem.move: Move an already identified file to another path inside BAXY's private work folder, verifying its hash. Use when: moving a work-folder file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: the file is only known by its name (use filesystem_sandbox_move_named). Examples: «mueve ese archivo a la carpeta viejos», «pásalo a la subcarpeta 2025», «move it to archivo».
tools.filesystem.read.text: Read the text of an already identified file in BAXY's private work folder. Use when: reading a work-folder file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: a text file or PDF in the user's known folders (use file_read). Examples: «lee ese archivo», «¿qué dice ese txt de tu carpeta?», «read that file».
tools.filesystem.sandbox.diff.named: Compare two text files in BAXY's private work folder, each given by its exact file name, and say which lines differ. Use when: compara a con b or en qué se diferencian. Do not use when: finding duplicate files (use filesystem_known_duplicates). Examples: «compara version1.txt con version2.txt», «¿qué cambia entre notas.txt y notas_viejas.txt?», «diff de config.json y config2.json».
tools.filesystem.sandbox.move.named: Move a file, given by its exact file name, to another path inside BAXY's private work folder. Use when: moving a work-folder file the person names. Do not use when: the file was already identified by id (use filesystem_move). Examples: «mueve informe.txt a la carpeta archivo», «pasa notas.txt a viejos», «move log.txt to backup».
tools.filesystem.search: Search files by name in BAXY's private work folder (sandbox), not the user's folders. Use when: searching BAXY's own work folder. Do not use when: Desktop, Documents or Downloads (use file_find). Examples: «busca informe en tu carpeta de trabajo», «¿tienes algún archivo log en tu carpeta?», «search notas en tu workspace».
tools.game.catalog.list: List the games in the local Steam library, optionally filtered by text. Use when: qué juegos tengo. Do not use when: one game's ownership or install state (use game_entitlement_named or game_installed_named), playing (use game_launch). Examples: «¿qué juegos tengo en steam?», «lista mis juegos», «muéstrame mi biblioteca de steam».
tools.game.entitlement.named: Check whether a Steam or Epic game is in the person's library and whether it is installed, without downloading or opening anything. Use when: do I own it or is it in my library. Do not use when: only installed-on-disk (use game_installed_named), downloading (use game_install_named), playing (use game_launch), opening Steam itself (use app_open). Examples: «¿tengo el hollow knight en steam?», «¿está fall guys en mi biblioteca de epic?», «do I own portal 2?».
tools.game.install.cancel: Cancel the partial download of one specific Steam game. Use when: cancela or para la descarga of a named game. Do not use when: canceling every download (use game_install_cancel_active), uninstalling (use game_uninstall_named). Examples: «cancela la descarga de dota», «para de bajar el cs2», «stop downloading terraria».
tools.game.install.cancel.active: Cancel all game downloads Steam has in progress. Use when: cancel downloads with no game named, or all of them. Do not use when: one specific game is named (use game_install_cancel). Examples: «cancela todas las descargas de steam», «para las descargas», «stop all steam downloads».
tools.game.install.named: Download and install a Steam or Epic game by its title. It checks the library itself: call it directly, never game_installed_named or game_entitlement_named first. Use when: descarga or instala a game. Do not use when: only asking whether it is installed or owned (use game_installed_named or game_entitlement_named), checking progress (use game_install_status), a normal program that is not a game (use package_install). Examples: «descarga el hollow knight», «instala fall guys en epic», «install terraria de steam».
tools.game.install.status: Check how the download or installation of an already identified Steam game is going. Use when: cómo va or cuánto le falta a una descarga. Do not use when: asking whether it is installed (use game_installed_named), starting a download (use game_install_named). Examples: «¿cómo va la descarga de dota?», «¿cuánto le falta al cs2?», «install progress de terraria». Only while a download or install is in progress; whether a game is installed or downloaded at all is game_installed_named.
tools.game.installed.named: Answer only whether a Steam or Epic game is installed on this PC, by name, without opening it. Use when: the request is a question («¿está instalado X?»). Do not use when: abre/juega/lanza (use game_launch for a game; «abre steam» is app_open), library ownership (use game_entitlement_named), normal apps (use app_installed). Examples: «¿tengo instalado el minecraft?», «¿está instalado el gta v?», «is rocket league installed?». Only for yes/no questions about installation; a request to play or open the game is game_launch.
tools.game.launch: Launch (play) a Steam game the person owns. Use when: juega, abre or lanza a specific game title. Do not use when: opening Steam, Epic or any normal application (use app_open), only asking whether it is installed (use game_installed_named). Examples: «abre el hollow knight», «quiero jugar terraria», «lanza el cs2». A wish to play a game the person names is a launch, not an installed-check.
tools.game.uninstall.named: Uninstall an installed Steam game by its title, after confirmation. Use when: desinstala a game. Do not use when: a normal program (use package_uninstall), canceling a download (use game_install_cancel). Examples: «desinstala worms rumble», «borra el dota de steam», «uninstall terraria».
tools.input.key.press: Press one key or shortcut in the active window (Enter, Escape, Tab, arrows, Ctrl+S/Z/F/T/W, Alt+Tab, F5, Ctrl+Shift+Esc). Ctrl+W can close the whole window, so BAXY asks the person first. Use when: a key or shortcut is named. Do not use when: typing text (use input_text_type), select all (use input_select_all), copy or paste (use clipboard_copy or clipboard_paste), clicking a button (use input_visible_click). Examples: «presiona enter», «aprieta escape», «dale ctrl z».
tools.input.keyboard.layout: Switch the keyboard input language of the active window to Spanish. Use when: pon el teclado en español. Do not use when: only asking which language it is (use input_keyboard_status), the on-screen keyboard (use input_keyboard_open). Examples: «cambia el teclado a español», «pon el teclado en español», «teclado in spanish please».
tools.input.keyboard.open: Open the Windows on-screen keyboard. Use when: teclado en pantalla or teclado virtual. Do not use when: changing the keyboard language (use input_keyboard_layout), typing text (use input_text_type). Examples: «abre el teclado en pantalla», «muéstrame el teclado virtual», «open on-screen keyboard».
tools.input.keyboard.status: Read the input language of the active window's keyboard, without changing it. Use when: en qué idioma está el teclado. Do not use when: changing it (use input_keyboard_layout). Examples: «¿en qué idioma está el teclado?», «¿el teclado está en inglés?», «keyboard layout actual?».
tools.input.pointer.control: Move the mouse pointer to the screen center, click where it is, or scroll down. Use when: a raw mouse action with no target named. Do not use when: clicking a named button or option (use input_visible_click), scrolling a web page (use browser_control). Examples: «haz clic», «mueve el mouse al centro», «scrollea hacia abajo».
tools.input.scroll: Scroll the active window or a named list or panel up or down by an amount. Use when: baja, sube or desplázate in a page, list or document on screen. Do not use when: moving the mouse pointer (use input_pointer_control), clicking a visible option (use input_visible_click). Examples: «baja un poco la página», «sube en la lista», «scroll down».
tools.input.select.all: Select everything in the focused control of the active window, like Ctrl+A. Use when: selecciona todo. Do not use when: copying (use clipboard_copy; select and copy are separate steps). Examples: «selecciona todo», «marca todo el texto», «select all».
tools.input.text.type: Type a given literal text where the cursor is, in the active window. Use when: escribe or tipea a stated text. Do not use when: pasting the clipboard (use clipboard_paste), a chat message to someone (use message_draft), writing a file (use file_write), pressing a key (use input_key_press). Examples: «escribe hola mundo», «tipea buenos días», «escribe mi correo: ana@gmail.com».
tools.input.visible.click: Click a control or a text you saw in your last look at the window (input_visible_controls), by its label, adding its index when the look gave one. Use when: going to a section, tab or menu of an open app, or pressing a button there. Do not use when: the section is an app_open place (Windows Settings pages, Steam library or store, Discord directs: use app_open with place), you have not looked at the window yet (look first), a raw click where the pointer is (use input_pointer_control), going to a web address (use browser_navigate). Examples: «haz clic en aceptar», «pulsa guardar», «entra a Tu biblioteca» (after looking at Spotify).
tools.input.visible.controls: Look at an application window: returns its visible controls (index, kind, name, state) and the text on screen. Use when: you must act inside an open app or read what it shows — before clicking, typing or answering about it — or the person asks what is on screen; set application to the app's name (for example right after opening it). Do not use when: the text of a web page is wanted (use browser_page_read). Examples: «entra a Tu biblioteca en Spotify» (look at Spotify, then click «Tu biblioteca»), «¿qué marca la calculadora?», «¿qué botones hay?».
tools.media.control: Pause, play, resume, stop, skip to next or go back to previous on what is already playing. Use when: pausa, siguiente, skip, anterior or dale play without naming new content. Do not use when: playing something new by name (use media_play_query, media_play_exact, media_play_youtube or streaming_play_named), seeking seconds (use media_seek_relative), muting (use audio_mute). Examples: «pausa la música», «siguiente canción», «dale play».
tools.media.play.exact: Play one exact song by its title on Spotify, not just open the app: the result titled as title (case, accents and punctuation aside) is played and the now-playing line must name it; a song already playing is left as it is (alreadyPlaying, nothing pressed); when several songs carry that title, nothing plays and they come back as candidates (title, artist): say them, or use media_play_query with the title and the artist. Use when: a precise song title is given. Do not use when: an artist, genre or loose search (use media_play_query), YouTube or a video (use media_play_youtube), a movie or series (use streaming_play_named), only opening Spotify (use app_open). Examples: «pon la canción Bohemian Rhapsody», «reproduce Despacito exacta en spotify», «play the song Yellow».
tools.media.play.query: Search music on Spotify (song, artist or style) with query exactly as you write it and play the first result of Spotify's own search (the result titled as query, case, accents and punctuation aside, when Spotify shows one). The receipt says which control was pressed (selectedControl) and what plays (title, observedNowPlaying), not whether it is what was asked for. Use when: pon or play X, where X is any song, artist, podcast or style, even one you do not know or that sounds misheard: pass X as you heard it. Do not use when: one exact song title (use media_play_exact), YouTube or a video (use media_play_youtube), a movie or series (use streaming_play_named), resuming (use media_control), only opening Spotify (use app_open). Examples: «pon música de bad bunny», «ponme algo de rock en spotify», «play some lofi».
tools.media.play.youtube: Search a video on YouTube and play it. Use when: YouTube is named or a video is wanted. Do not use when: music on Spotify (use media_play_query or media_play_exact), Netflix, Disney+ or HBO Max titles (use streaming_play_named), only opening youtube.com (use browser_navigate). Examples: «pon un video de gatos en youtube», «ponme el tráiler de dune en youtube», «play lofi en youtube».
tools.media.seek.relative: Skip forward or back a number of seconds in what is playing. Use when: adelanta or retrocede N segundos. Do not use when: next or previous track (use media_control). Examples: «adelanta 30 segundos», «retrocede 10 segundos», «skip 1 minute».
tools.media.status: Read what is playing now: title, artist and whether it is paused, without changing anything. Use when: qué canción es or qué está sonando. Do not use when: the volume (use audio_status). Examples: «¿qué canción está sonando?», «¿cómo se llama esta canción?», «what's playing?».
tools.memory.correct: Correct a fact BAXY already remembers, replacing its value with a new one. Use when: the person fixes a remembered datum. Do not use when: saving a new fact (use memory_save), forgetting it (use memory_forget). Examples: «corrige: mi color favorito es el verde», «no, mi perro se llama Toby, no Tobi», «actualiza mi equipo favorito a Colo-Colo».
tools.memory.disable: Turn BAXY's memory off so it stops saving and reading facts. Use when: desactiva la memoria or deja de recordar. Do not use when: forgetting specific data (use memory_forget), clearing only this conversation (use memory_session_clear). Examples: «desactiva tu memoria», «deja de recordar cosas», «turn off memory».
tools.memory.enable: Turn BAXY's private memory on. Use when: activa la memoria. Do not use when: only asking whether it is on (use memory_status). Examples: «activa tu memoria», «vuelve a recordar cosas», «enable memory».
tools.memory.export: Prepare a private export of what BAXY remembers into Documents, without secret data. Use when: exporta or saca una copia de la memoria. Do not use when: just listing it (use memory_list). Examples: «exporta lo que recuerdas», «sácame una copia de tu memoria», «export memory».
tools.memory.forget: Make BAXY forget remembered facts (one fact, a topic, a kind or all), after confirming what is deleted. Use when: olvida X or borra lo que sabes de X. Do not use when: only this conversation (use memory_session_clear), turning memory off (use memory_disable), changing a value (use memory_correct). Examples: «olvida mi dirección», «borra todo lo que recuerdas», «forget my birthday».
tools.memory.list: List everything BAXY remembers. Use when: a general question about all remembered facts. Do not use when: one concrete thing (use memory_recall), notes (use note_list). Examples: «¿qué cosas recuerdas?», «lista tu memoria», «what do you remember?».
tools.memory.recall: Ask BAXY what it remembers about one concrete thing. Use when: cuál es mi X or te acuerdas de X. Do not use when: everything remembered (use memory_list), searching notes (use note_search). Examples: «¿cuál es mi color favorito?», «¿te acuerdas de mi cumpleaños?», «¿qué recuerdas de mi perro?».
tools.memory.save: Ask BAXY to remember a fact, preference or rule that is not sensitive. Use when: recuerda que or acuérdate de que. Do not use when: sensitive or secret data (use memory_sensitive_save), it must ring or remind at a time (use schedule_alarms), a note (use note_create), a to-do (use task_create). Examples: «recuerda que mi color favorito es el azul», «acuérdate de que prefiero respuestas cortas», «remember que mi perro se llama Toby».
tools.memory.sensitive.save: Ask BAXY to remember a sensitive or secret datum (health, ID numbers, keys). Use when: the fact to remember is sensitive. Do not use when: an ordinary fact or preference (use memory_save). Examples: «recuerda mi RUT 12.345.678-9», «guarda que soy alérgico a la penicilina», «remember mi clave del wifi».
tools.memory.session.clear: Delete only what was remembered in this conversation, keeping permanent memory. Use when: olvida lo de esta conversación. Do not use when: forgetting permanent facts, or everything about the person (use memory_forget). Examples: «olvida lo que hablamos ahora», «borra la memoria de esta sesión», «clear this session».
tools.memory.status: Report whether BAXY's memory is on and what its limits are. Use when: asking if memory is active. Do not use when: listing remembered facts (use memory_list). Examples: «¿está activa tu memoria?», «¿puedes recordar cosas?», «memory status».
tools.message.draft: Leave a message written for someone in WhatsApp or Discord without sending it; the person sends it. Use when: escríbele or mándale un mensaje a X. Do not use when: an email (use email_send), a test send (use message_send_test). Examples: «escríbele a mamá por whatsapp que llego a las 8», «mándale a Pedro en discord que se conecte», «dile a Ana por wsp hola». Only a chat named exactly so (case and accents aside) is opened; when none is, or several are, nothing is written and the names the chat list showed come back as candidates.
tools.message.send.test: Really send a test message or email, always forced to the owner's test channel, never to the person named. Use when: a mensaje or correo de prueba is asked for. Do not use when: a normal message to a contact (use message_draft), a normal email (use email_send). Examples: «manda un mensaje de prueba por whatsapp», «envía un correo de prueba», «test message en discord».
tools.network.dns.status: Read which DNS servers the PC's connection uses. Use when: qué DNS uso. Do not use when: IP addresses (use network_ip_list), general connectivity (use network_status). Examples: «¿qué dns tengo?», «muéstrame los servidores dns», «dns actuales?».
tools.network.ip.list: List this PC's own IP addresses. Use when: cuál es mi IP. Do not use when: DNS servers (use network_dns_status), testing another host (use network_ping). Examples: «¿cuál es mi ip?», «dime mis direcciones ip», «what's my ip».
tools.network.ping: Ping a host or address once and say whether it answers and how long it takes. Use when: haz ping or responde X. Do not use when: general internet connectivity (use network_status). Examples: «haz ping a google.com», «¿responde 8.8.8.8?», «ping a cloudflare».
tools.network.port.list: List the PC's open listening TCP and UDP ports. Use when: qué puertos están abiertos. Do not use when: running programs (use system_process_list). Examples: «¿qué puertos tengo abiertos?», «lista los puertos en escucha», «open ports?».
tools.network.status: Check whether there is internet connectivity and which network connections are active: online is Windows' own internet check, and connectivity says internet, constrained (a sign-in portal or limited access), local (a network without internet) or none. Use when: tengo internet. Do not use when: Wi-Fi specifically (use wifi_status), pinging a host (use network_ping). Examples: «¿tengo internet?», «¿estoy conectado a la red?», «network status».
tools.note.create: Create a private note with a title and free-text content. Use when: crea una nota or toma nota. Do not use when: a to-do or list item (use task_create), something that rings or reminds at a time (use schedule_alarms), a fact for BAXY to remember (use memory_save), a text file (use file_write). Examples: «crea una nota que diga comprar pan», «toma nota: ideas para la tesis», «haz una nota reunión con Juan».
tools.note.list: List the notes, active or in the trash. Use when: qué notas tengo. Do not use when: searching inside notes (use note_search), tasks (use task_list). Examples: «¿qué notas tengo?», «muéstrame las notas borradas», «list my notes».
tools.note.read: Read one note by its title. Use when: lee la nota X. Do not use when: searching notes by text (use note_search). Examples: «lee la nota ideas», «¿qué dice la nota de compras?», «read note tesis».
tools.note.restore: Restore a deleted note from the trash, by its title. Use when: recupera la nota X. Do not use when: a task (use task_restore). Examples: «recupera la nota ideas», «restaura la nota que borré», «undelete note compras».
tools.note.search: Search the notes that contain a text. Use when: busca en mis notas. Do not use when: files (use file_find), tasks (use task_search), the internet (use web_search). Examples: «busca en mis notas la palabra tesis», «¿en qué nota puse el teléfono de Juan?», «search notes for receta».
tools.note.trash: Delete a note by its title, moving it to a recoverable trash. Use when: borra la nota X. Do not use when: a task (use task_delete), a file (use filesystem_known_trash_named). Examples: «borra la nota ideas», «elimina la nota de compras», «delete note tesis».
tools.note.update: Change the title or the content of an existing note. Use when: cambia or edita la nota X. Do not use when: a new note (use note_create), a task (use task_update). Examples: «cambia la nota ideas a 'llamar al profe'», «edita la nota compras: leche y pan», «renombra la nota tesis a proyecto».
tools.ocr.read: Read the text that appears in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id). Use when: the text on screen or in a capture is wanted. Do not use when: describing what is seen (use vision_describe), the open web page (use browser_page_read), no capture yet (use capture_screenshot first). Examples: «lee el texto de la captura», «¿qué dice en la pantalla?», «haz OCR de la captura».
tools.office.document.create: Create a new Office document, Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx), with a title. Use when: crea un documento de Word or una planilla Excel. Do not use when: a PowerPoint (use document_presentation_create), a plain text file (use file_write). Examples: «crea un documento de word llamado informe», «haz una planilla excel de gastos», «new word doc tesis».
tools.office.document.read: Read the content of an already identified Office document. Use when: reading a document created or identified earlier. Do not use when: a PDF or a text file (use file_read). Examples: «lee ese documento», «¿qué dice el word que creaste?», «read that doc».
tools.package.install: Install a normal program on the PC with winget and verify it is installed, after confirmation. If the name is not exactly one package, nothing is installed and the result lists the candidates winget gave (name, packageId, source): call again with the packageId of the one the person wants, or ask which. alreadyInstalled true means it was there and nothing ran. winget_install_still_running means the installer started and has not finished: say it is installing, not that it is installed. Use when: instala, descarga e instala or pon a program. Do not use when: uninstalling (use package_uninstall), a Steam or Epic game (use game_install_named), opening it (use app_open). Examples: «instala spotify», «bájame el vlc», «install 7-zip».
tools.package.uninstall: Uninstall a normal program from the PC by its name and verify it is gone, after confirmation. Use when: desinstala a program. Do not use when: installing (use package_install), a Steam game (use game_uninstall_named), closing it (use app_close). Examples: «desinstala discord», «quita el zoom del pc», «uninstall vlc».
tools.peripheral.list: List connected peripherals (mouse, keyboard, printer, scanner, USB), optionally of one kind. Use when: qué periféricos hay or is a mouse or printer connected. Do not use when: USB drives and free space (use storage_removable_list), Bluetooth devices (use bluetooth_device_list), monitors (use display_status). Examples: «¿qué periféricos hay conectados?», «¿hay una impresora conectada?», «lista los dispositivos usb».
tools.peripheral.print: Print an already identified document on a printer. Use when: imprime. Do not use when: listing printers (use peripheral_list). Examples: «imprime ese documento», «mándalo a la impresora», «print it».
tools.peripheral.scan: Scan a document with a scanner. Use when: escanea. Do not use when: a screenshot (use capture_screenshot), reading text from a capture (use ocr_read). Examples: «escanea este documento», «usa el escáner», «scan a page».
tools.schedule.alarms: Set, list or cancel BAXY's alarms and reminders, which ring on this PC (Windows Task Scheduler; also on battery and waking it from sleep, not when it is shut down), or check why one did not ring. Use when: an alarm, a timer, a wake-up or a reminder at a time or in some minutes, which ones are set, or cancelling one. Do not use when: a to-do without a time (use task_create), a calendar event (use calendar_event_create), a note (use note_create). Examples: «recuérdame en 20 minutos sacar la ropa» (create, inMinutes 20), «despiértame mañana a las 7» (create, alarm, at 07:00), «qué alarmas tengo» (list), «cancela la alarma de las 7» (cancel, at 07:00).
tools.shell.command.run: Run a PowerShell console command and return its output; a command that does more than read (writes, deletes, installs, sends, runs a program) waits for the person's yes. Use when: ejecuta or corre a command. Do not use when: a dedicated operation exists (system_process_list, network_ping, app_open). Examples: «ejecuta ls en el escritorio», «corre pytest en documentos/proyecto», «run git status».
tools.software.python.package.status: Check whether a Python package is installed, and its version, in each registered Python, without installing anything. Use when: tengo X instalado for a Python package. Do not use when: which Python versions exist (use software_python_status), normal apps (use app_installed). Examples: «¿tengo instalado numpy?», «¿qué versión de pandas tengo?», «is requests installed?».
tools.software.python.status: List the Python versions installed on the PC. Use when: qué python tengo. Do not use when: a Python package (use software_python_package_status). Examples: «¿qué versión de python tengo?», «¿está instalado python?», «python versions?».
tools.storage.removable.list: List the USB drives and pendrives connected now and their free space. Use when: hay un pendrive or cuánto espacio le queda al USB. Do not use when: the internal disk (use system_status), other peripherals (use peripheral_list). Examples: «¿hay un pendrive conectado?», «¿cuánto espacio le queda al usb?», «lista los discos externos».
tools.streaming.navigate: Go to an exact content address on a streaming service (Netflix, HBO Max, Prime Video, YouTube), without searching by title. Use when: a specific streaming link or id is already known. Do not use when: a title is named (use streaming_play_named), a YouTube search (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «abre este link de netflix: netflix.com/watch/123», «ve a esa dirección de hbo max», «open this prime video link».
tools.streaming.play.named: Play a movie or series by its title on Netflix, Disney+ or HBO Max and verify the video advances. Only the search result named as title (case and accents aside) is opened: write the title as the service names it; when none is, nothing plays and the names the search showed come back as candidates. A «who is watching» profile screen stops it: the person picks the profile. Use when: a film or series title is named. Do not use when: music (use media_play_query or media_play_exact), YouTube videos (use media_play_youtube), only opening the Netflix app (use app_open). Examples: «pon stranger things en netflix», «quiero ver Moana en disney plus», «play The Last of Us en hbo max».
tools.system.application.crash.diagnose: Report which applications crashed or hung recently. Use when: why did an app close by itself or which apps froze. Do not use when: running processes (use system_process_list), alarms not ringing (use schedule_alarms). Examples: «¿qué aplicaciones se cayeron hoy?», «¿por qué se cerró el chrome?», «any app crashes recently?».
tools.system.identity: Read which Windows user account BAXY runs under; it does not tell the person's name. Use when: con qué usuario de Windows. Do not use when: the person's own name (use memory_recall). Examples: «¿con qué cuenta de windows corres?», «¿qué usuario de windows es este?», «whoami».
tools.system.power: Lock, sign out, sleep, shut down or restart the PC. Use when: apaga, reinicia, bloquea or suspende el PC. Do not use when: closing apps (use app_close or window_close_all), radios (use wifi_radio_set or bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «apaga el pc», «reinicia el computador», «bloquea la pantalla». Never use it to silence, mute or lower sound: that is audio_mute. Turning the PC off is only for apaga/shut down.
tools.system.process.list: List running processes, sorted by CPU, memory or name. Use when: qué procesos corren or qué consume más. Do not use when: whether one app has an open window (use window_application_status), overall CPU or RAM (use system_status). Examples: «¿qué procesos usan más memoria?», «lista los programas corriendo», «top cpu processes».
tools.system.process.terminate.named: Force-kill a program by its executable name, with confirmation; this is not a normal window close. Use when: mata, fuerza el cierre or the program no responde. Do not use when: a normal close of an app (use app_close), closing all windows (use window_close_all). Examples: «fuerza el cierre de chrome.exe», «mata el proceso de spotify», «kill discord que se pegó».
tools.system.recyclebin.empty: Empty the Windows Recycle Bin. Use when: vacía la papelera. Do not use when: deleting one file (use filesystem_known_trash_named). Examples: «vacía la papelera», «limpia la papelera de reciclaje», «empty recycle bin».
tools.system.settings.adjust: Raise or lower screen brightness by an amount from its current level. Use when: sube or baja el brillo with an amount. Do not use when: a target brightness level is given (use system_settings_set), volume (use audio_volume_adjust). Examples: «sube el brillo 20», «bájale 10 al brillo», «brightness down 15».
tools.system.settings.set: Set brightness to a level, or turn do-not-disturb, airplane mode or BAXY's accessible mode on or off; can also turn BAXY's confirmation bypass off. Use when: brillo al N, no molestar, modo avión. Do not use when: brightness by an amount (use system_settings_adjust), Wi-Fi or Bluetooth alone (use wifi_radio_set or bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «pon el brillo al 70», «activa el modo avión», «activa no molestar».
tools.system.settings.status: Read the current screen brightness, or whether airplane mode is on, without changing it. Use when: en cuánto está el brillo. Do not use when: changing it (use system_settings_set or system_settings_adjust). Examples: «¿en cuánto está el brillo?», «¿qué brillo tiene la pantalla?», «¿está activado el modo avión?».
tools.system.status: Read PC status: CPU, memory, disk, battery, graphics card and Windows. Use when: battery, RAM, disk or specs questions. Do not use when: per-process usage (use system_process_list), monitors (use display_status), USB drives (use storage_removable_list). Examples: «¿cuánta batería tengo?», «¿cuánta ram estoy usando?», «¿qué tarjeta gráfica tengo?».
tools.system.time: Read the current date and time, here or in another place or time zone. Use when: qué hora es or qué día es. Do not use when: weather, «qué tiempo hace» included (use weather_current), setting an alarm (use schedule_alarms), the calendar (use calendar_event_list). Examples: «¿qué hora es?», «¿qué hora es en Tokio?», «¿qué fecha es hoy?». Always use it for the time or date in another city or country; never state another place's time from memory.
tools.task.complete: Mark a to-do as done or cross an item off a list. Use when: ya lo hice or tacha X. Do not use when: deleting it (use task_delete). Examples: «marca como hecha la tarea pagar la luz», «tacha el pan de la lista del súper», «done con la tarea informe».
tools.task.create: Create a to-do or add an item to a list (shopping, pending); its optional date schedules no notification. Use when: agrega X a la lista or anota de pendiente. Do not use when: it must ring or remind at a time (use schedule_alarms), free-text notes (use note_create), a calendar event (use calendar_event_create). Examples: «agrega leche a la lista del súper», «anota de pendiente llamar al banco», «add task terminar el informe».
tools.task.delete: Delete a task or remove an item from a list, moving it to a recoverable trash. Use when: borra or quita X de la lista. Do not use when: marking it done (use task_complete), a note (use note_trash). Examples: «quita el pan de la lista», «borra la tarea informe», «delete task banco».
tools.task.list: List tasks and lists (shopping, pending): open, done or deleted. Use when: qué tengo pendiente or qué hay en la lista. Do not use when: alarms or reminders (use schedule_alarms), the calendar (use calendar_event_list), notes (use note_list). Examples: «¿qué tengo pendiente?», «léeme la lista del súper», «show completed tasks».
tools.task.reopen: Reopen a task that had been marked as done. Use when: desmarca or it was not done after all. Do not use when: restoring a deleted task (use task_restore). Examples: «reabre la tarea informe», «desmarca el pan, no lo compré», «reopen task banco».
tools.task.restore: Restore a deleted task. Use when: recupera la tarea que borré. Do not use when: reopening a completed task (use task_reopen). Examples: «recupera la tarea que borré», «restaura llamar al banco», «undelete task informe».
tools.task.search: Search the tasks whose title or details contain a text. Use when: busca en mis tareas. Do not use when: notes (use note_search), files (use file_find). Examples: «busca tareas sobre la tesis», «¿tengo alguna tarea con banco?», «search tasks informe».
tools.task.update: Change the title, details or date of a task or a list item. Use when: cambia la fecha or el nombre de la tarea X. Do not use when: marking it done (use task_complete), a note (use note_update). Examples: «cambia la tarea informe para el lunes», «renombra la tarea banco a ir al banco», «update task pan: dos marraquetas».
tools.vision.describe: Describe what is seen in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id). Use when: qué ves en la pantalla or describe la captura. Do not use when: only the text (use ocr_read), the clickable controls (use input_visible_controls), no capture exists yet (use capture_screenshot first). Examples: «¿qué ves en la captura?», «describe lo que hay en pantalla», «what's on my screen?».
tools.weather.current: Read the current weather and tomorrow's forecast, here or in a named place. When several places of comparable size carry the name, or none does, nothing is read and they come back as candidates (name, region, country): ask which one, or call again with the region or country. Use when: clima, qué tiempo hace, temperatura, va a llover, or whether to take an umbrella or a jacket. Do not use when: news (use web_search with source news), the time (use system_time). Examples: «¿cómo está el clima?», «¿va a llover mañana en Santiago?», «weather en Valparaíso».
tools.web.download: Download a file or image from the internet into a known folder (Downloads by default), by its public web address (url; never this PC or the local network); the address of a web page downloads the image that page announces as its cover. Without an address, find one first with web_search and download a result's url. Use when: descarga or bájame a file or image. Do not use when: a game (use game_install_named), just viewing a page (use browser_navigate). Examples: «descarga la imagen de portada de wikipedia.org al escritorio», «bájame un meme», «download ejemplo.com/manual.pdf».
tools.web.fetch: Read one public web page (http or https) as plain text: its title, final address and text. A long page comes in pages: when hasMore is true, call it again with offset set to nextOffset to read on; bodyTruncated true means the page was longer than BAXY reads (1.5 MB) and its text stops there. Never call it again with the same url and offset: the same text comes back. Use when: the person gives a link or asks what a page says, or to read a page a web_search result points to. Do not use when: looking something up (use web_search), showing the page to the person (use browser_navigate), saving a file (use web_download). Examples: «léeme esta página https://…», «¿qué dice el primer resultado?», «read https://example.com/news».
tools.web.search: Look something up in one public source and return what that source returned, as it gave it. Choose «source»: «web» (default): a web search engine; each result has title, url and snippet. «news»: the news, on a topic or the latest ones when none is named (query: the topic, or «noticias»); each item has title, outlet, url and time. «encyclopedia»: Wikipedia in «language» (es or en, default es); each article has title, url and its opening lines. «currency»: a conversion; «from» and «to» are ISO 4217 codes (USD, EUR, CLP, MXN, ARS…), «amount» the number to convert (default 1); returns the rate, its date and the converted amount. «sports»: a team's match; «team» is the team's name as a sports site writes it (Boca Juniors, Los Angeles Lakers, national sides in English: Spain, Chile), «wants» is next (default) or last; returns that match as the calendar gives it, with the team it found. «places»: sites of a kind in a place; «kind» is the kind of site in English (pharmacy, parking, restaurant, atm), «place» the place with its city and country (Plaza de Armas, Santiago, Chile); returns names, addresses and distances. Results are what the source returned, not checked against the question: judge them yourself, and to read a result's page call web_fetch with its url. Use when: what changes over time or what you are not sure of: news, prices, schedules, results, currency conversions, a team's next or last match, places near me or in a named place. Do not use when: what you know for sure and does not change (definitions, geography, science, well-known history): answer it yourself; weather (use weather_current), opening a site or results page in the browser (use browser_navigate), playing YouTube (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «¿qué pasó hoy en el congreso?» → source news, query «congreso»; «¿cuánto son 100 dólares en pesos chilenos?» → source currency, from USD, to CLP, amount 100; «¿cuándo juega Boca?» → source sports, team «Boca Juniors», wants next; «farmacias cerca de mí» → source places, kind «pharmacy», nearby true; «busca opiniones del iPhone 17» → source web. It only reads information: never use it to buy, order, book, pay or do anything the person asked you to do; if no tool performs that action, say in one sentence that you don't do that.
tools.wifi.connect: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network already identified by its profile id. Use when: the network was identified earlier in the conversation. Do not use when: the network is said by name or by place such as casa or trabajo (use wifi_connect_named). Examples: «conéctate a esa red», «sí, conéctate», «connect to it».
tools.wifi.connect.named: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network by its name or by its place (casa, trabajo, oficina). Use when: conéctate al wifi X or al de la casa. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio on (use wifi_radio_set), seeing networks around (use wifi_scan). Examples: «conéctate al wifi de la casa», «conéctate a la red MiCasa5G», «connect al wifi del trabajo».
tools.wifi.disconnect: Disconnect from the current Wi-Fi network. Use when: desconéctate del wifi. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio off (use wifi_radio_set). Examples: «desconéctate del wifi», «sal de esta red», «disconnect wifi».
tools.wifi.ensure.connected: Check that Wi-Fi is already connected, without changing anything. Use when: a step must make sure Wi-Fi is connected. Do not use when: the person simply asks whether they are connected (use wifi_status), connecting (use wifi_connect_named). Examples: «asegúrate de que el wifi esté conectado», «comprueba que sigo en el wifi», «make sure wifi is connected».
tools.wifi.profile.list: List the Wi-Fi networks saved on the PC. Use when: qué redes tengo guardadas. Do not use when: networks around now (use wifi_scan). Examples: «¿qué redes wifi tengo guardadas?», «lista mis redes guardadas», «saved wifi networks».
tools.wifi.radio.set: Turn the PC's Wi-Fi on or off. Use when: prende or apaga el wifi. Do not use when: leaving one network only (use wifi_disconnect), airplane mode (use system_settings_set), Bluetooth (use bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «apaga el wifi», «prende el wifi», «turn wifi on».
tools.wifi.radio.status: Read whether Wi-Fi is on or off, without changing it. Use when: está prendido el wifi. Do not use when: whether it is connected to a network (use wifi_status). Examples: «¿está prendido el wifi?», «¿tengo el wifi activado?», «wifi on or off?».
tools.wifi.scan: List the Wi-Fi networks available around now, with their signal. Use when: qué redes hay disponibles. Do not use when: saved networks (use wifi_profile_list). Examples: «¿qué redes wifi hay disponibles?», «busca redes wifi», «scan wifi».
tools.wifi.status: Check whether the PC is connected to a Wi-Fi network right now. Use when: estoy conectado al wifi. Do not use when: general internet (use network_status), radio on or off (use wifi_radio_status). Examples: «¿estoy conectado al wifi?», «¿tengo wifi?», «wifi status».
tools.window.active: Tell which window or application is in the foreground now. Use when: qué ventana está activa or al frente. Do not use when: whether a named app is open (use window_application_status). Examples: «¿qué ventana tengo activa?», «¿qué programa está al frente?», «what window is this?».
tools.window.application.status: Check whether a named application is open with a visible window, without opening it. Use when: está abierto X. Do not use when: opening it (use app_open), whether it is installed (use app_installed), which window is in front (use window_active). Examples: «¿está abierto el spotify?», «¿tengo el chrome abierto?», «is discord open?».
tools.window.close.all: Close all open windows at once (the person's editors and terminals too), except BAXY's own, after the person's yes; never forces, so a window that asks to save stays open. Use when: cierra todo or todas las ventanas. Do not use when: one app (use app_close), only hiding windows to see the desktop (use window_minimize_all). Examples: «cierra todas las ventanas», «cierra todo», «close everything».
tools.window.focus: Bring an open window to the front . Use when: cambia a, ve a or trae al frente an open app. Do not use when: the app is not open (use app_open), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «tráeme al frente el chrome», «cambia a la ventana de word», «focus spotify».
tools.window.maximize: Maximize an already identified window. Use when: maximiza or agranda la ventana. Do not use when: back to normal size (use window_restore), fullscreen video in the browser (use browser_control). Examples: «maximiza el chrome», «agranda la ventana», «maximize word».
tools.window.minimize: Minimize one already identified window, not all. Use when: minimiza X or esta ventana. Do not use when: minimizing everything to show the desktop (use window_minimize_all), closing it (use app_close). Examples: «minimiza el spotify», «minimiza esta ventana», «minimize chrome».
tools.window.minimize.all: Minimize all windows to show the desktop, closing nothing. Use when: minimiza todo or muéstrame el escritorio. Do not use when: one window or one named application (use window_minimize), closing all windows (use window_close_all). Examples: «minimiza todo», «muéstrame el escritorio», «minimize all».
tools.window.move: Move an already identified window to another position on the screen (x, y). Use when: mueve la ventana a a position. Do not use when: the left or right half (use window_snap), changing its size (use window_resize). Examples: «mueve el chrome arriba a la izquierda», «mueve la ventana a 100, 100», «move notepad a la esquina».
tools.window.resize: Resize an already identified window to a given width and height. Use when: cambia el tamaño a N por M. Do not use when: maximizing (use window_maximize), half the screen (use window_snap). Examples: «haz la ventana de 800 por 600», «cambia el tamaño del bloc de notas a 1024x768», «resize chrome to 1280x720».
tools.window.resolve: List the open windows of an application or process, each with its windowId, title, state and whether it is in front. Use when: you need the windowId of an open app's window to focus, maximize, minimize, restore, snap, move or resize it. Do not use when: only whether the app is open (use window_application_status), the window in front (use window_active). Examples: «maximiza el chrome» (resolve chrome, then window_maximize), «pon el bloc de notas a la izquierda», «minimiza spotify».
tools.window.restore: Return an already identified minimized or maximized window to its normal size. Use when: restaura or devuelve la ventana a su tamaño. Do not use when: only bringing it to front (use window_focus), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «restaura la ventana del chrome», «vuelve el spotify a tamaño normal», «restore word».
tools.window.snap: Place an already identified window on the left or right half of the screen. Use when: pon X a la izquierda or a la derecha. Do not use when: exact coordinates (use window_move), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «pon el chrome a la izquierda», «manda el word a la mitad derecha», «snap spotify right».

file.write.relativePath: The path inside folder (the known folder itself, Documents or Desktop, goes in folder), with every subfolder the person named: «Proyectos/notas.txt». The full path they said (C:\Users\ana\Proyectos\notas.txt) also works.
file.write.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory or relativePath).
file.write.append: true adds the text as a new last line («añade al final») and keeps the file.
file.write.expectedSha256: Only to replace a file that exists: the fileSha256 file_read gave for it. version_conflict means the file exists: read it first, or use append.
file.write.text: The file's whole new content exactly as the person dictated it (line breaks allowed); with append true, only the line to add.

filesystem.create.directory.relativePath: The path inside folder (the known folder itself, Documents or Desktop, goes in folder), with every subfolder the person named: «Proyectos/notas.txt». The full path they said (C:\Users\ana\Proyectos\notas.txt) also works.
filesystem.create.directory.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs. Without it, BAXY's private work folder.

file.read.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
file.read.offset: Where to go on reading the same file: the nextOffset its last result gave (hasMore true). Without it the file starts again from the beginning.
file.read.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory or relativePath); all_known only when they named no folder.
file.read.fileName: The file's name with extension («notas.txt»), the relativePath file_find gave (then leave subdirectory out), or the full path the person said.
file.read.maximumCharacters: How many characters per page (default 4000, up to 200000); leave it out unless the person wants a long file in fewer pages.

file.find.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
file.find.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory or relativePath); all_known only when they named no folder.
file.find.content: A text to look for inside the files («reunión con Juan»), when the person asks which file mentions it. Leave it out to search by name.
file.find.limit: How many files to return, at most (default 20; 50 when listing the folder); leave it out unless the person asked for a number.
file.find.order: recent for the newest first («lo último», «más recientes»), size for the largest first; leave it out for name order.
file.find.query: Part of the file's name («presupuesto») or a pattern («*.pdf»). Leave it and content out to list what the folder holds.

file.edit.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
file.edit.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory or relativePath); all_known only when they named no folder.
file.edit.fileName: The file's name with extension («notas.txt»), the relativePath file_find gave (then leave subdirectory out), or the full path the person said.
file.edit.newText: The text that takes oldText's place, exactly as it must read; empty deletes oldText.
file.edit.oldText: The exact text to replace, copied as file_read showed it (case, accents, spaces); it must appear once unless replaceAll is true.
file.edit.replaceAll: true when the person asks to change every occurrence («todas las veces»); otherwise leave it out, and a repeated oldText changes nothing.

filesystem.known.trash.named.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
filesystem.known.trash.named.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory or relativePath); all_known only when they named no folder.
filesystem.known.trash.named.fileName: The exact name of the file or folder to delete, with its extension («viejo.txt»); no path: a subfolder goes in subdirectory.

filesystem.folder.open.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
filesystem.folder.open.folder: The known folder to open: desktop, documents, downloads, pictures, or home (the user's folder, also for any other folder of theirs, named in subdirectory).

media.control.sourceApp: Only to control a player other than what is playing now: the sourceAppUserModelId media_status gave for it, exactly as it gave it. Leave it out to control what is playing.
media.control.action: pause, play (resume), toggle (play if paused, pause if playing), stop, next (skip to the next track) or previous.

input.key.press.target: Where the keyboard is: message_composer when the focused field holds a message to someone, so Enter or Space sends it (BAXY then asks the person first); text_field when it is any other text field, so Delete only erases characters (without it, Delete deletes what is selected and BAXY asks first). Leave it out otherwise.
input.key.press.onto: The exact label, as your last look showed it, of the control Enter or Space presses (the focused button, or the result chosen in a list). A control that sends, joins a call, buys or deletes makes BAXY ask the person first. Leave it out when the key presses no control.
input.key.press.consequence: overwrite when the key confirms replacing a file that already exists (Enter on the focused «Sí» of «¿Desea reemplazarlo?»): BAXY asks the person first. Leave it out otherwise.
input.key.press.key: The key or shortcut the person named, as one value (enter, escape, ctrl_z, alt_tab); ctrl_l focuses a browser's address bar; ctrl_w may close the window.
input.key.press.window: The number after «window» in your last input_visible_controls look at that window, so the key goes there; leave it out to press it in the window in front.

input.visible.click.consequence: overwrite when the click confirms replacing a file that already exists (the «Sí» of «¿Desea reemplazarlo?»): BAXY asks the person first. Leave it out otherwise.
input.visible.click.search: Text to type into the search box the click opens, in the same step; then the result named exactly as that text (or as choose) is pressed. If none is, nothing is pressed and the names seen are returned.
input.visible.click.choose: With search: the exact name of the result to press among those the search shows. Judged like a label: one that sends, joins a call, buys or deletes makes BAXY ask the person first.
input.visible.click.manner: How to press it: double (double click), menu (open its context menu), open (only open its drop-down or split arrow). Leave it out for a normal click.
input.visible.click.controlId: The id your last look gave for that control, when its label repeats on the screen; label must still name the same control.
input.visible.click.index: The [number] before that control in your last look, when the look gave one; label must still name that same control.
input.visible.click.label: The control's name exactly as your last look showed it between « ».
input.visible.click.window: The number after «window» in your last input_visible_controls look at that window, so the click acts there; leave it out only for the window in front.

memory.recall.selector: With scope exact: the name the memory was saved under (as memory_list shows it). Case, accents and spacing do not matter; a part of the name does not match.
memory.recall.scope: exact for one named thing (selector its name); kind for all of one kind (selector fact, preference, rule or context); all for everything (selector null).

input.visible.controls.wanted: Words of what you look for in that window (a name, a button). The view keeps sixty controls; with these words, up to ten more whose names have one of them as a whole word are added after those. Leave it out for the usual view.
