input.visible.controls.tail: true to keep the last entries of a long window (a conversation's newest messages) when the view is cut, instead of the first ones.
input.visible.controls.application: The app to look at, by name («Spotify»), right after opening it or when it is not in front; leave it out for the window just opened or in front.
input.visible.controls.includeText: true to also read the text written on screen (messages, results), besides the controls.
input.visible.controls.limit: How many controls to show, at most (default and maximum 60).
input.visible.controls.lines: true to read the window's written lines with their place, for a chat or document; it implies includeText.
input.visible.controls.waitForLabel: A label the app should show soon (after opening or a click): the look waits up to 24 seconds for it to appear.

web.fetch.offset: Where to go on reading the same page: the nextOffset its last result gave (hasMore true). Without it the page starts again from the beginning.
web.fetch.maximumCharacters: How many characters per page (default 4000, up to 20000); leave it out unless more text per call is needed.
web.fetch.url: The page's full public address with https:// («https://example.com/news»), as given or from a web_search result.

audio.volume.level: The level the person wants the volume at, 0 to 100: the number after «a», «al», «en» or «hasta», also with sube or baja.

audio.volume.adjust.amount: How much to change it from where it is now: only when the person gave no level to end at («sube 10», «baja 5»).
audio.volume.adjust.direction: up to raise it (sube, más), down to lower it (baja, menos).

app.open.place: A section to open directly, only for an app that declares it: «Configuración» (Windows Settings pages), «Steam» (library, store, community, a game's page, results), «Spotify» (home, search, results) or «Discord» (directs).
app.open.appId: One name from the installed list below, exactly as written there (Configuración is Windows Settings), the closest to what the person said; another name opens nothing.
app.open.forControl: true, so BAXY can read and press its window; false only when the person asks to run it as administrator.
app.open.foreground: true when the person asked to open or see it, so it comes to the front; false only when you open it to work in it behind their window.
app.open.newDocument: true only when the person wants a new, empty document of the app («un bloc de notas nuevo»): a new window opens, never one they had.
app.open.placeValue: With place results (Spotify, Steam): the words to search; with Steam place game: the game's Steam number. Leave it out for any other place: a value there opens nothing.

wifi.connect.named.place: casa, oficina or trabajo whenever the person said one.
wifi.connect.named.profileName: The network's name; when only a place was said, repeat that word.

note.read.title: The note's title as the person said it.
note.read.noteId: Leave it out and give title; only when a title matched several notes, the noteId of the one meant among the candidates.

file.open.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents, downloads or pictures when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs, with that folder before the file in name («Proyectos\informe.docx»).
file.open.application: The installed app the person named to open it with («paint», «fotos»), as app_open's appId; leave it out for the file's default app.
file.open.foreground: true when the person asked to open it, so they see it in front; leave it out only when you open it to work in it.
file.open.name: The file's name with extension («tarea.docx»), with its subfolders inside folder when said («proyecto/informe.docx»); never a full C:\ path.

app.close.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.

app.installed.name: The application's name as the person said it («zoom», «obs studio»).

audio.app.volume.adjust.amount: How much to move it, 1 to 100, as the person said («bájale 20»): counted from its current level, not the level to end at.
audio.app.volume.adjust.app: The application's name as the person said it (spotify, discord, chrome); it needs an open audio session (it plays or played sound).
audio.app.volume.adjust.direction: up to raise it (sube, más), down to lower it (baja, menos).

audio.app.volume.set.app: The application's name as the person said it (spotify, discord, chrome); it needs an open audio session (it plays or played sound).
audio.app.volume.set.level: The level to end at, 0 to 100: the number after «al» or «a» («pon el spotify al 30»).

audio.microphone.mute.state: true mutes the microphone (silencia, mutea); false turns it back on (activa, quita el mute).

audio.mute.state: true mutes the PC sound; false unmutes it (quítale el mute, activa el sonido).

backup.create.expectedSha256: The sha256 filesystem_read_text gave for that same resourceId (filesystem_list gives none); a file changed since is refused.
backup.create.resourceId: The resourceId filesystem_list or filesystem_search gave for that file in BAXY's work folder; the person's folders have none.

backup.known.create.folder: The folder to back up: desktop, documents, pictures, projects (Documents\Projects or the user's Projects), or all_known for documents, pictures and desktop together.

backup.known.list.limit: How many backups to list, at most (default 20); leave it out unless the person asked for a number.

backup.known.restore.latest.folder: The folder whose latest ZIP backup to restore: desktop, documents, pictures or projects; all_known takes the latest backup of any of them.

backup.known.verify.latest.folder: The folder whose latest ZIP backup to check: desktop, documents, pictures or projects; all_known checks the latest backup of any of them.

backup.list.limit: How many file backups to list, newest first (default 20); leave it out unless the person asked for a number.

backup.restore.backupId: The backupId backup_list or backup_create gave (backup_ and 32 hex characters); never a file name.
backup.restore.destinationRelativePath: A new path inside BAXY's work folder, with the file name («restaurados/informe.txt»); an existing file or folder there is refused.

backup.verify.backupId: The backupId backup_list or backup_create gave (backup_ and 32 hex characters); never a file name.

bluetooth.device.pair.deviceId: The deviceId bluetooth_device_list gave for that device; when it says the id expired, list again. Never the device's name.

bluetooth.radio.set.state: true turns Bluetooth on (prende, activa); false turns it off (apaga, desactiva).

browser.control.action: back (previous page), reload, scroll_down or scroll_up (move the page), new_tab, fullscreen_video (the video playing), close (this tab), close_all (every tab of that window).

browser.navigate.url: The full address with https:// («https://youtube.com»); to search there, the engine's results address («https://www.google.com/search?q=…»). A bare «youtube.com» is refused.

browser.navigate.named.browser: The browser the person named: opera, opera_gx (Opera GX), chrome, edge or brave.
browser.navigate.named.url: The full address with https:// («https://gmail.com»); a bare «gmail.com» is refused.

browser.page.read.maximumCharacters: How much page text to read, 256 to 32768 (default 12000); leave it out unless more of a long page is needed.

browser.tabs.list.limit: How many tabs to list, at most (default 20); leave it out unless the person asked for a number.

calculator.expression.evaluate.expression: Numbers with + - * / only, no parentheses; the Calculator applies each operator in the order typed, so «(12+8)*3» is written «12+8*3».

calendar.event.create.endUtc: When it ends, in UTC ending in Z («2026-10-16T19:00:00Z»): the person's local time moved by the clock line's UTC offset; after startUtc.
calendar.event.create.startUtc: When it starts, in UTC ending in Z («2026-10-16T18:00:00Z»): the person's local time moved by the clock line's UTC offset.
calendar.event.create.title: The event's name as the person said it («reunión con Juan», «dentista»), without the date or time.

calendar.event.list.endUtc: The end of the span, in UTC ending in Z: local time moved by the clock line's UTC offset; after startUtc, at most 366 days later.
calendar.event.list.startUtc: The start of the span, in UTC ending in Z («2026-10-16T03:00:00Z» is local midnight at UTC-3): local time moved by the clock line's offset.

capture.active.window.folder: Only when the person asks to keep the capture: desktop, documents, downloads, or pictures (its Screenshots subfolder) gets a PNG. Leave it out to only capture.

capture.screenshot.folder: Only when the person asks to keep the capture: desktop, documents, downloads, or pictures (its Screenshots subfolder) gets a PNG. Leave it out to only capture.

client.channel.locate.name: The channel or chat name as the person said it («general», «memes»); only a row named exactly so counts as found.

clipboard.read.text.maxCharacters: How many characters to read at most (default 8192); leave it out unless a longer clipboard must be read whole.

clipboard.write.text.text: Exactly the text the person dictated to put there, without «copia al portapapeles» or the quotes around it.

desktop.wallpaper.set.color: A solid colour as #RRGGBB («#004E98» blue, «#000000» black): turn the colour the person named into it; a name like «azul» is refused. Leave it out for an image.
desktop.wallpaper.set.folder: With name, for an image: desktop, documents, downloads or pictures, where the image is. Leave it out for a colour.
desktop.wallpaper.set.name: With folder: the image's file name with extension, directly in that folder («playa.jpg»), no subfolders. Leave it out for a colour.

document.presentation.create.folder: Where to save the .pptx: desktop, documents or downloads, as the person said; without it, Documents.
document.presentation.create.slides: One string per slide, as many as asked (up to 12): its title on the first line, then up to 8 bullet lines, separated by \n.
document.presentation.create.title: The presentation's title; it is also the file name (an existing one gets « (2)»).

email.latest.reply.text: The reply's text as the person dictated it («llego tarde»), without «respóndele que».

email.send.subject: The subject only when the person gives one; leave it out otherwise (the start of the text is used).
email.send.text: The email's body as the person dictated it, without «manda un correo a…».
email.send.to: The recipient's email address exactly as the person said it («juan@gmail.com»).

file.compress.folder: The known folder holding the file or folder to zip: desktop, documents, downloads or pictures.
file.compress.name: The exact name of the file (with extension) or folder directly in that folder, no subfolders; the zip goes next to it and must not exist yet.

filesystem.copy.destinationRelativePath: The new path inside BAXY's work folder, with the file name («respaldo/notas.txt»); an existing file or folder there is refused.
filesystem.copy.expectedSha256: The sha256 filesystem_read_text gave for that same resourceId (filesystem_list gives none); a file changed since is refused.
filesystem.copy.resourceId: The resourceId filesystem_list or filesystem_search gave for that file in BAXY's work folder; the person's folders have none.

filesystem.explorer.count.extension: The extension to count, with or without the dot: «py», «.pdf», «jpg».
filesystem.explorer.count.folder: The known folder the person named: desktop, documents, downloads, home or pictures. Leave it out only for «esta carpeta» (the File Explorer window in front).

filesystem.file.open.latest.folder: The known folder to take the newest file from: downloads for «lo último que descargué», otherwise desktop, documents or pictures as said.

filesystem.known.duplicates.limit: How many groups of duplicates to return, at most (default 20); leave it out unless the person asked for a number.

filesystem.list.limit: How many entries to list, at most (default 50).
filesystem.list.relativeDirectory: A folder inside BAXY's work folder to list («respaldo»); leave it out for its top level.

filesystem.move.destinationRelativePath: The new path inside BAXY's work folder, with the file name («respaldo/notas.txt»); an existing file or folder there is refused.
filesystem.move.expectedSha256: The sha256 filesystem_read_text gave for that same resourceId (filesystem_list gives none); a file changed since is refused.
filesystem.move.resourceId: The resourceId filesystem_list or filesystem_search gave for that file in BAXY's work folder; the person's folders have none.

filesystem.read.text.maximumBytes: Leave it out (reads up to 1 MB); a file larger than this is refused, not cut.
filesystem.read.text.resourceId: The resourceId filesystem_list or filesystem_search gave for that file.

filesystem.sandbox.diff.named.leftFileName: The first file's exact name in BAXY's work folder, with extension («version1.txt»).
filesystem.sandbox.diff.named.rightFileName: The second file's exact name in BAXY's work folder, with extension («version2.txt»).

filesystem.sandbox.move.named.destinationRelativePath: Where it goes inside BAXY's work folder, with the file name («viejos/notas.txt»); an existing file or folder there is refused.
filesystem.sandbox.move.named.sourceFileName: The file's exact name in BAXY's work folder, with extension («informe.txt»); it must be the only file so named there.

filesystem.search.limit: How many matches to return, at most (default 50).
filesystem.search.query: Part of the file name to find in BAXY's work folder («informe»); no path.

game.catalog.list.limit: How many games to list, at most (default 50).
game.catalog.list.query: Words of a game's name to filter by («counter»); leave it out to list the whole library.

game.entitlement.named.store: epic when the person names Epic Games; leave it out for Steam.
game.entitlement.named.title: The game's title as the person said it («hollow knight», «portal 2»).

game.install.cancel.appId: The game's Steam AppID number, as game_install_named, game_install_status or game_catalog_list gave it; never the title.

game.install.named.store: epic when the person names Epic Games; leave it out for Steam.
game.install.named.title: The game's title as the person said it («fall guys», «terraria»).

game.install.status.appId: The game's Steam AppID number, as game_install_named, game_install_status or game_catalog_list gave it; never the title.

game.installed.named.provider: steam or epic when the person names that store; any to check both.
game.installed.named.title: The game's title as the person said it («minecraft», «gta v»).

game.launch.appId: The appId of one game in the library list below: the title closest to what the person said, even misheard; never an invented number.

game.uninstall.named.store: Leave it out (Steam); epic is refused: BAXY does not uninstall Epic games.
game.uninstall.named.title: The installed game's title as the person said it («worms rumble»).

input.pointer.control.action: move_center (pointer to the screen's center), click (where the pointer already is), scroll_down (wheel down).

input.scroll.amount: How many wheel steps, 1 to 10; «un poco» is about 3.
input.scroll.direction: down or up, as the person said (baja, sube).
input.scroll.index: The [number] of the list or panel to scroll in your last look; leave it out to scroll the window itself.
input.scroll.label: The name of an element of that window that is out of view, to bring it into view without the wheel; needs window.
input.scroll.window: The number after «window» in your last input_visible_controls look at that window, so it scrolls there; leave it out to scroll the window in front.

input.text.type.entry: true when text is an entry of the field's own drop-down list (a ComboBox) to choose; needs index and window. Nothing is typed freely then.
input.text.type.index: The [number] of the field in your last look that receives the text; needs window.
input.text.type.replace: true to replace what the field holds instead of adding to it; needs index, never for a document or a password.
input.text.type.text: Exactly the text to type, without line breaks or tabs: press Enter or Tab with input_key_press.
input.text.type.window: The number after «window» in your last input_visible_controls look at that window, so the text goes there; leave it out to type where the cursor is.

media.play.exact.title: The song's exact title as the person said it, without the artist («Bohemian Rhapsody»).

media.play.query.query: What to search, as the person said it: an artist, song, podcast or style («bad bunny», «rock», «lofi»), even when it sounds misheard.

media.play.youtube.query: The search words for the video, as the person said them («video de gatos», «tráiler de dune»).

media.seek.relative.seconds: Seconds to move: positive to skip forward (adelanta), negative to go back (retrocede); one minute is 60.

memory.correct.expectedValue: Leave it out; only to change it if it still is the value memory_recall showed: that current value.
memory.correct.kind: Leave it out; if given, it must be the kind the memory was saved with.
memory.correct.retention: The retention it was saved with, as memory_recall or memory_list show it (usually persistent); another one finds nothing.
memory.correct.selector: The name the memory was saved under, as memory_recall or memory_list show it.
memory.correct.value: The new value the person gave («verde», «Toby»).

memory.forget.scope: exact: one memory (selector its name); topic: those whose name or tag is selector; kind: all of one kind (fact, preference, rule, context); all: everything (selector null).
memory.forget.selector: What scope needs: the memory's name, the topic word or the kind; null with scope all.

memory.list.limit: How many to list: 20 unless the person asked for more (1 to 100).
memory.list.offset: 0 for the first page; to go on, the previous offset plus limit.

memory.save.expiryPolicy: Leave it out with retention persistent; session_end with session; after_relevance_window with temporary. Any other pairing is refused.
memory.save.kind: fact (a datum), preference (how the person likes things), rule (how BAXY must behave), context (their current situation).
memory.save.retention: persistent to remember for good (the usual); session only for this conversation; temporary for 24 hours.
memory.save.selector: A short name for what is remembered, in the person's words («color favorito», «nombre del perro»): the name it is recalled by later.
memory.save.tags: One-word topics for it («perro», «trabajo»), so memory_forget with scope topic finds it; [] when none.
memory.save.value: The datum itself («azul», «Toby», 42, true), without its name.
memory.save.sensitivity: normal, or personal for data about the person's private life (family, address, birthday); only a label: both are shown when recalled.

memory.sensitive.save.expiryPolicy: Leave it out with retention persistent; session_end with session; after_relevance_window with temporary. Any other pairing is refused.
memory.sensitive.save.kind: fact (a datum), preference (how the person likes things), rule (how BAXY must behave), context (their current situation).
memory.sensitive.save.retention: persistent to remember for good (the usual); session only for this conversation; temporary for 24 hours.
memory.sensitive.save.selector: A short name for what is remembered, in the person's words («color favorito», «nombre del perro»): the name it is recalled by later.
memory.sensitive.save.tags: One-word topics for it («perro», «trabajo»), so memory_forget with scope topic finds it; [] when none.
memory.sensitive.save.value: The datum itself («azul», «Toby», 42, true), without its name.
memory.sensitive.save.sensitivity: secret for keys and passwords, sensitive for health data or ID numbers; either way recall shows it hidden, never the value.

message.draft.channel: whatsapp or discord, as the person said (wsp and wasap are whatsapp).
message.draft.recipient: The contact's name exactly as the person said it (a name or a family word: «mamá»); never a phone number.
message.draft.text: Only the message to leave written, as the person dictated it («llego a las 8»), without «dile que».

message.send.test.channel: whatsapp, discord or email: the channel the test is asked on.
message.send.test.requestedRecipient: Who the person named as recipient, only recorded: the test always goes to the owner's test channel. «prueba» when they named nobody.
message.send.test.text: The test message's text as dictated; «mensaje de prueba» when none was given.

network.ping.host: The host name or IP address as said («google.com», «8.8.8.8»), without http:// or a path.

network.port.list.limit: How many ports to list, at most (default 50).

note.create.content: The note's text as the person dictated it («comprar pan»).
note.create.title: A short title: the one the person gave, or a few words of the content when they gave none.

note.list.limit: How many notes to list (default 50, up to 100).
note.list.offset: 0 for the first page; to go on, the nextOffset the last note_list gave.
note.list.scope: active (the default), trashed for deleted notes («borradas»), all for both.

note.restore.noteId: Leave it out and give title; only when a title matched several notes, the noteId of the one meant among the candidates.
note.restore.title: The deleted note's title as the person said it.

note.search.includeTrashed: true to also search deleted notes; leave it out otherwise.
note.search.limit: How many notes to return, at most (default 20).
note.search.query: The word or text to find inside the notes («tesis», «teléfono de Juan»).

note.trash.noteId: Leave it out and give title; only when a title matched several notes, the noteId of the one meant among the candidates.
note.trash.title: The note's title as the person said it.

note.update.content: The note's whole content after the change; to keep it, the content note_read gave. It replaces what was there.
note.update.expectedRevision: The revision note_read gave for this note just before.
note.update.expectedTitle: The note's current title, exactly as note_read gave it.
note.update.noteId: The noteId note_read gave for this note.
note.update.title: The note's title after the change: the new one when renaming, otherwise its current title unchanged.

ocr.read.captureId: The captureId capture_screenshot or capture_active_window gave.
ocr.read.language: Leave it out (the PC's own languages); only a language tag such as «en-US» when the text is in another language.

office.document.create.format: docx for Word (documento), xlsx for Excel (planilla, hoja de cálculo).
office.document.create.title: The document's title as the person said it («informe», «gastos»).

package.install.packageId: The winget id («Spotify.Spotify») or the program's name as the person said it («spotify», «vlc»); after candidates, the packageId of the one wanted.
package.install.version: Leave it out (the latest); only an exact version the person named.

package.uninstall.packageId: The program's name as the person said it («discord») or its winget id; after candidates, the packageId of the one wanted.

peripheral.list.kind: Only the kind asked about: mouse, keyboard, printer, scanner or usb; leave it out (all) otherwise.

peripheral.print.deviceId: The deviceId peripheral_list (kind printer) gave for the printer.
peripheral.print.documentId: The documentId office_document_create gave for the document.

peripheral.scan.deviceId: The deviceId peripheral_list (kind scanner) gave for the scanner.

schedule.alarms.action: create a new one, list the ones set, cancel one, or diagnose why one did not ring.
schedule.alarms.at: Local 24-hour time HH:mm («07:00», the next time it comes) or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm for another day. With cancel: the time of the one to cancel.
schedule.alarms.inMinutes: With create: minutes from now («en 20 minutos» is 20), instead of at.
schedule.alarms.inSeconds: With create: seconds from now, 10 to 86400, for a short timer («en 30 segundos»), instead of at.
schedule.alarms.kind: alarm for alarms and wake-ups, reminder otherwise (the default); with cancel, the kind of the one to cancel.
schedule.alarms.limit: With list: how many to list, at most (default 20).
schedule.alarms.recurrence: daily or hourly only when the person says it repeats («todos los días», «cada hora»); leave it out for once.
schedule.alarms.title: Required with create: what it is for, as the person said it («sacar la ropa», «despertar»).

shell.command.run.command: One PowerShell command line exactly as asked («git status», «ls»); no line breaks.
shell.command.run.cwd: Where to run it: desktop, documents, downloads or home, optionally with a subfolder («documents/proyecto»), or a full path. Leave it out only when the person named no folder.

software.python.package.status.package: The package's pip name as the person said it («numpy», «requests»).

streaming.navigate.resourceUri: The full https:// address of the content on that service's own site («https://www.netflix.com/watch/123»); another site is refused.
streaming.navigate.service: The service the address belongs to: netflix, hbo_max, prime_video or youtube.

streaming.play.named.service: netflix, disney_plus (Disney+) or hbo_max (HBO Max), as the person said.
streaming.play.named.title: The movie or series title as the service names it («Stranger Things», «Moana»).

system.application.crash.diagnose.hours: How far back to look, in hours (default 24, up to 168 for a week).
system.application.crash.diagnose.limit: How many events to return, at most (default 20).

system.power.action: lock (bloquea), signout (cierra sesión), sleep (suspende), shutdown (apaga), restart (reinicia): only the one the person said.

system.process.list.limit: How many processes to list (default 10, up to 50).
system.process.list.sort: cpu for what uses most processor, memory for most RAM, name for alphabetical order.

system.process.terminate.named.name: The program's executable name («chrome», «spotify.exe»), not its window title.

system.settings.adjust.amount: How many points to move the brightness, 1 to 100, as the person said («sube el brillo 20»).
system.settings.adjust.direction: up to raise it (sube), down to lower it (baja).

system.settings.set.setting: brightness, do_not_disturb (no molestar), airplane_mode (modo avión), accessible_mode (BAXY's accessible interface), confirmation_bypass (BAXY's no-confirmation mode; can only be turned off).
system.settings.set.value: For brightness the level 0 to 100; for the others 1 turns it on and 0 off (confirmation_bypass takes only 0).

system.settings.status.setting: brightness for the screen's level, airplane_mode for whether airplane mode is on.

system.status.scope: What to read: battery, cpu, memory (RAM), cpu_memory, disk, gpu_identity (which graphics card), gpu_usage (its load), os (Windows), os_memory, or summary (all, the default).

system.time.place: The city, country or time zone the person named («Tokio», «Madrid»); leave it out for the time here.

task.complete.expectedVersion: The task's version from the latest task_list or task_search result for it.
task.complete.taskId: The taskId task_list or task_search gave for that task.

task.create.details: Extra details the person gave beyond the title; leave it out when none.
task.create.due: Only when the person gives a date: their local date, or date and time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm), not UTC; it rings nothing.
task.create.title: The to-do or list item as the person said it («leche», «llamar al banco»).

task.delete.expectedVersion: The task's version from the latest task_list or task_search result for it.
task.delete.taskId: The taskId task_list or task_search gave for that task.
task.delete.reviewLabel: The task's title exactly as task_list or task_search gave it; another text deletes nothing.

task.list.includeDeleted: true to also show deleted tasks (needed to restore one); leave it out otherwise.
task.list.limit: How many tasks to list, at most (default 20).
task.list.status: open (the default) for pending ones, completed for done ones, all for both.

task.reopen.expectedVersion: The task's version from the latest task_list or task_search result for it.
task.reopen.taskId: The taskId task_list (status completed) or task_search gave for that task.

task.restore.expectedVersion: The task's version from the latest task_list or task_search result for it.
task.restore.taskId: The taskId task_list with includeDeleted true gave for the deleted task.

task.search.limit: How many tasks to return, at most (default 20).
task.search.query: The word or text to find in the tasks' titles and details («banco», «tesis»).
task.search.status: all (the default), open for pending ones, completed for done ones.

task.update.details: The task's details after the change, replacing the current ones; empty when it has none.
task.update.due: The local date and time after the change (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, not UTC); to keep it, the dueUtc task_list gave; null removes it.
task.update.expectedVersion: The task's version from the latest task_list or task_search result for it.
task.update.taskId: The taskId task_list or task_search gave for that task.
task.update.title: The task's title after the change: the new one when renaming, otherwise its current title from task_list.

vision.describe.captureId: The captureId capture_screenshot or capture_active_window gave.
vision.describe.prompt: Leave it out for a plain description; only the person's own question about the image («¿qué dice el error?»).

weather.current.dialectCountry: The country the person's Spanish marks (CL, AR, MX, ES, CO, VE): among same-named places of similar size it picks that country's. Leave it out otherwise.
weather.current.location: The place's own name, optionally «, region or country» («Valencia, España»); leave it out for where this PC is.

web.download.folder: Where to save it: desktop, documents, downloads or pictures, as the person said; without it, Downloads.
web.download.name: Leave it out to keep the file's own name; only a name the person gave («meme.jpg»). An existing name gets « (2)», never overwritten.
web.download.url: The file's or page's full public address, as said or from a web_search result; a page gives the image it announces as its cover.

web.search.amount: With source currency: the number to convert («100 dólares» is 100); leave it out for 1.
web.search.from: With source currency: the ISO 4217 code to convert from (USD, EUR, CLP, MXN, ARS).
web.search.kind: With source places: the kind of site, in English («pharmacy», «parking», «restaurant», «atm»).
web.search.language: With encyclopedia or news: es (the default) or en, the Wikipedia or news edition.
web.search.nearby: true only when the person asks for something near them: this PC's city and country are added (for places, they are the place).
web.search.place: With source places: the place with its city and country («Plaza de Armas, Santiago, Chile»); leave it out with nearby.
web.search.query: What you look for; for web, news and encyclopedia, the words searched, with years as numbers («2026», not «este año»).
web.search.source: web (default, a search engine), news (events), encyclopedia (Wikipedia), currency (a conversion), sports (a team's match), places (sites of a kind in a place).
web.search.team: With source sports: the team's name as sports sites write it («Boca Juniors»; national sides in English: «Spain»).
web.search.to: With source currency: the ISO 4217 code to convert to.
web.search.wants: With source sports: next (the default) for the coming match, last for the one played.

wifi.connect.profileId: The profileId wifi_profile_list or wifi_status gave for that network; never the network's name.

wifi.radio.set.state: true turns Wi-Fi on (prende); false turns it off (apaga).

window.application.status.name: The application's name as the person said it («spotify», «chrome»).

window.focus.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.

window.maximize.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.

window.minimize.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.

window.move.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.
window.move.x: Pixels from the desktop's left edge to the window's left side (0 is the far left).
window.move.y: Pixels from the desktop's top edge to the window's top side (0 is the top).

window.resize.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.
window.resize.height: The new height in pixels («800 por 600»: 600).
window.resize.width: The new width in pixels («800 por 600»: 800).

window.resolve.applicationName: The installed app's exact name («Google Chrome», «Spotify») to list its windows; then leave process, byTitle and offset out.
window.resolve.byTitle: With process only: true when process holds words of a window title instead of a program name.
window.resolve.limit: How many windows to list (default 20, up to 50).
window.resolve.offset: With process only: the nextOffset of the last page, to go on; leave it out for the first page.
window.resolve.process: Instead of applicationName: a program name («chrome»), or * for every window; with byTitle true, words of the window title.

window.restore.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.

window.snap.windowId: The windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the fresh one the last window action gave back; never windowHandle or another number.
window.snap.side: left or right half of the screen, as the person said.
